commercial_invoice.name: Commercial invoice
checks: Quantity and total value match the customs declaration
Quantity matches what intake recorded for the shipment
Buyer matches the counterparty in the registered foreign trade contract
Goods description and HS code match the certificate of origin and phytosanitary certificate

packing_list.name: Packing list
checks: Net and gross weight match the invoice and the railway bill / air waybill
Packaging material is declared — wooden packaging needs an ISPM 15 mark

trade_contract.name: Foreign trade contract

fields.name: Identification number of foreign trade contract

checks: Registered in UEISFTO — the identification number exists before the customs declaration is created
Contract is valid on the shipment date

railway_bill.name: Railway bill (SMGS consignment note)
railway_bill.specimen: SMGS blank (325) and filled KZ→UZ bill (477)
checks: Consignee and destination station match the contract and invoice
Weight matches the packing list and what intake recorded
Seal numbers match those applied after customs inspection

cmr_note.name: CMR consignment note
cmr_note.specimen: International consignment note CMR (161, 57) — box numbers as printed on the standard form

fields.name: Place and date of taking over (box 4)

checks: Sender, consignee and goods match the contract and invoice
Gross weight matches the invoice and what intake recorded
Place of delivery is in the destination country of the case

air_waybill.name: Air waybill
checks: Pieces and weight match the packing list
Consignee matches the contract

shippers_letter.name: Shipper's letter of instruction
checks: Shipper, consignee and weight match the air waybill and packing list

phytosanitary_certificate.name: Phytosanitary certificate
phytosanitary_certificate.specimen: UZ blank IPPC form (325) and filled KZ certificate (477)
checks: Produce, quantity and consignee match the invoice and contract
Issued on or after the inspection (and fumigation, if any) date
Destination country matches the route

certificate_of_origin.name: Certificate of origin
certificate_of_origin.specimen: Forms CT-1, Form A and general form (306/325/540/868)
checks: Goods description and weight match the invoice
The form (CT-1, Form A, general) matches the destination country's origin proof

receipt_of_payment.name: Receipt of payment
receipt_of_payment.specimen: Treasury КВИТАНЦИЯ (325) and generic bank receipt (540)
checks: Payment purpose carries the platform reference <case>-P<step>, so the receipt matches this case and step
Amount equals the invoice or offer agreement being paid
Payer INN matches the company profile

invoice_for_payment.name: Invoice for payment
invoice_for_payment.specimen: СЧЕТ на оплату (325) and airport СЧЁТ ПРЕДОПЛАТА (540)
checks: Receipt amount equals this total
Customer matches the company profile

power_of_attorney.name: Power of attorney

fields.name: Scope naming the counterparty (e.g. railway station, Transportation Unit)

checks: Representative's name matches the passport presented
Valid on the date of the visit

offer_agreement.name: Offer agreement
offer_agreement.specimen: Оферта шартномаси, Uzbek (325) — agreement no, date, service table

fields.key: Tax Identification Number of the organization or individual
fields.name: Tax Identification Number of the organization or individual

fields.key: Full name of an organization's manager
fields.name: Full name of an organization's manager

checks: TIN and organisation name match the company profile
Payment sum matches the receipt paid against it
Quantity of transport units matches the wagons ordered

quarantine_permit_application.name: Quarantine permit application
quarantine_permit_application.specimen: Single Window form — screenshot in procedure 477, section 7 (fields: modules/steps/application-forms.ts)

fields.name: Applicant: taxpayer type, INN, name, director, address, phone, fax; passport and patent for a private person
Importer: same as applicant, or its own taxpayer type, INN, name, address, phone
General: destination address, transit countries, transport method, customs clearance point, border crossing, purpose of import
Product: HS code, product name, quantity and unit, gross weight

checks: Product information matches the contract and invoice
Importer matches the company profile

quarantine_permit.name: Quarantine permit

fields.name: Border post and route of entry

checks: Valid on the arrival date
Product and quantity match the invoice

customs_declaration.name: Customs declaration
customs_declaration.specimen: ГТД / TD1, 54 boxes — filled (325) and blank IM70 (477)
checks: HS code consistent with the invoice and certificate of origin
Contract identification number matches the UEISFTO registration
Every permit or certificate it cites is in the case ledger
The procedure lists the phytosanitary certificate and certificate of origin as not obligatory to attach to an export declaration

cargo_transport_application.name: Application for cargo transportation (GU-12)
checks: Tonnes and wagons match what intake recorded
Destination station matches the route

food_test_report.name: Food test report
checks: Sample matches the imported product
Report date precedes the conclusion application

veterinary_certificate.name: Veterinary certificate
veterinary_certificate.specimen: Veterinary certificate Form-3 (57, 707) and the exporter-country certificate named in section 5
checks: Goods and quantity match the invoice
Issued after the veterinary permit and on or before the declaration

certificate_of_conformity.name: Certificate of conformity
certificate_of_conformity.specimen: Certificate of conformity from the certification body for fertilizers (57, 707)
checks: Product and HS code match the declaration
Valid on the date of release

passport.name: Passport
passport.specimen: Personal document (not parsed beyond identity fields)
checks: Name matches the power of attorney
Not expired on the date of the visit

vehicle_registration.name: Vehicle registration certificate
vehicle_registration.specimen: No specimen published — national vehicle registration certificate
checks: Registration number matches the transit declaration and the carriage permit

drivers_licence.name: Driver's licence
drivers_licence.specimen: No specimen published — national or international driving permit
checks: Category covers a heavy goods vehicle (C or CE)
Valid on the date of the crossing

atp_certificate.name: ATP certificate
atp_certificate.specimen: No specimen published — ATP certificate of compliance
checks: Vehicle matches the vehicle registration certificate
Valid on the date of carriage

carriage_permit.name: International carriage permit
carriage_permit.specimen: No specimen published — bilateral / ECMT road transport permit
checks: Country matches the route
Valid on the date of the crossing

tir_carnet.name: TIR carnet
tir_carnet.specimen: No specimen published — IRU TIR carnet
checks: Holder matches the carrier

cargo_control_book.name: Cargo delivery control book
cargo_control_book.specimen: No specimen published — cargo delivery control document
checks: Destination office matches the route

transit_declaration.name: Transit declaration
checks: Commodity code matches the case
Offices match the route

funds_certificate.name: Certificate on availability of funds
checks: Account holder matches the case's company
Issued recently

company_charter.name: Company charter
checks: Company matches the case's company

sanitary_conclusion.name: Sanitary-epidemiological conclusion
checks: Product matches the goods of the case

quality_certificate.name: Quality certificate / certificate of analysis
quality_certificate.specimen: No specimen published — quality certificate or certificate of analysis
checks: Product matches the goods of the case

veterinary_permit.name: Veterinary permit
checks: Goods match the case
